title: Coinbase Hackathon: Bringing DeFi to the World
description:
In our Hackathon of 2019, over 250 Coinbase employees submitted 51 ideas and demoed 31 projects to help bring DeFi to the world. 

DeFi, or decentralized finance, is an essential part of an open financial system. DeFi tools are censorship-resistant, unbiased, programmable, and available to anyone with a smartphone. For this hackathon, we focused on bringing DeFi to the world. Congrats to our Coinbase Hackathon Winter 2019 winners and all the participants. Want to come build with us? We saved a seat for you: visit http://coinbase.com/careers

► Visit Coinbase here: https://www.coinbase.com/about

► Learn more about Coinbase's mission here: https://www.coinbase.com/mission

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

► Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/coinbase
► Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/coinbase/
► Find us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coinbase/

#coinbase #Cryptocurrency #Blockchain #CoinbaseExchange #CoinbaseApp #OpenFinancialSystem  #CryptoForAll

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: Hackathons are a really important part of Coinbase's culture. I want to give people inside Coinbase an opportunity every year, if they have a good idea, to just go work on whatever they want because good ideas can come from anywhere. Hackathons are super critical. A lot of our focus is really on core, but also really expanding sort of a lot of the emerging opportunities in the market. Coinbase's vision has always been to build an open financial system and DeFi is probably the killer use case of this. It really is like the most mission fit that I've ever seen. DeFi is an opportunity to build a financial infrastructure that truly expands the world. Everybody is just sort of incredibly focused. So it's a really fun time to connect with your fellow co-workers, work with people on different teams and really explore those outrageous interesting ids that we don't always get the opportunity to build.
